flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui src/utils/models/Iwarrantofarrest.d.ts (type declaration only), pages/NoticeSearch/hook/{useSearch.ts,useSearchParams.tsx} (search by warrant_no), pages/NoticeSearch/form/NoticeSearchAllForm.tsx; ocmsadminapi api-authorization.properties (path list only). No entity/controller/service/cron for warrant of arrest in any of the six repos.
note: The story asks for a summary report of warrant status updates from State Courts and routing of errors to the OIC dashboard. There is no report, no source data (OCMS27.33 is absent), and Dashboard.tsx is empty. There is no entity, repository, controller, service, cron or SFTP/API client for Warrant of Arrest in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, thirdpartyapi or ocmseserviceapi (case-insensitive grep: warrant, woa, state court, send_to_sc, roms_error, warrantofarrest, woc_number; synonyms court mention/trial/outcome also checked). The only traces are the TypeScript type Iwarrantofarrest in ocmsadminui and a GET call to endpoint 'warrantofarrest' used to search notices; the path /v1/warrantofarrest is in the authorization list but no controller or entity serves it. The CAS inbound endpoints in CasIntegrationController (casGetPaymentStatus, casUpdateCourtNotices, plus-get-court-case-info, plus-payment-activation) are not credited: they are calls from CAS/PLUS to OCMS about court notices, not warrant updates to/from State Courts. Story status is blank in the data.
recommendation: Do not claim. The report and OIC dashboard routing do not exist and depend on OCMS27.33, which also does not exist.

steps.step: OCMS produces a summary report of processed warrant status updates
steps.detail: There is no warrant status report. The existing court reports are only 'Court Application Vault/Submit/Summon/Rejected Reports' with endpoints commented out (ActionReport.tsx:36-62), and there is no ReportList*.tsx for warrants. The data source (OCMS27.33) also does not exist.

steps.step: Processing errors are listed in the report
steps.detail: There is no recording of warrant status processing errors (roms_error_code is only a UI type field, Iwarrantofarrest.d.ts:28-30).

steps.step: Errors are routed to the OIC dashboard
steps.detail: Dashboard.tsx only renders a DataForm with an empty row (lines 19-34), with no widget or API call for errors to the OIC.
